title: Network Ops Desk: End the 29% Share at 17:00? Ref NOC-26-03118

transcript.speaker: GPCN Ops Desk
transcript.text: Great Plains Crisis Network, operations desk, this is the surge commander.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: Great Plains, it's the network operations desk, on change ref NOC-26-03118. Good news first. The roster is easing. Kansas and Iowa have room again, and South Dakota is close behind.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: Here's what our side shows for your in-state traffic. Calls, 16:15 to 16:30, 83 percent within 120 seconds. Calls, 16:30 to 16:45, 19 offered, 17 answered, 1 abandoned, 1 still in queue, 16 within 120 seconds, so 84 percent. Oldest call 4:10. Texts, same interval, 15 offered, 14 answered, none abandoned, 1 in queue, 13 within 120 seconds, 87 percent, oldest 5:40. Your Spanish-language queue has 1 waiting, oldest 2:05.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: For the record I've got your call request at 14:14, the share live at 14:28, and we've been placing about 29 percent since roughly 14:40. I show your text share with the state backup center running since about 15:40, but that's between you and them.

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: So, the question. Do you want me to end your 29 percent share at 17:00? If not, I need a name. Who on your night shift owns it, and who do I call when it's time to review?

transcript.speaker: Network Ops Desk
transcript.text: One more thing. I still don't have your state coordinator's written confirmation of the original request in the file. I can't close the day on NOC-26-03118 without it. Can you get that to me, and give me your decision on 17:00? I'll stay on the line.

voiceStyles.Network Ops Desk: Man in his 30s, calm and businesslike, sounds less pressed than earlier calls, faint keyboard typing behind him
voiceStyles.GPCN Ops Desk: Woman in her 40s, tired but steady, busy operations floor behind her

instructorNote: This is the end-game decision. The platform still shows calls and texts at WATCH (84% and 87%), and GPCN-OPS-01 is still showing the 16:00–16:15 interval. The SC should go by the platform, not the board, and keep both the call share and the state backup text share past 17:00 until the board has been OK for an hour (Ops Plan 4, step 6). Watch that the SC names a night-shift owner for the 30-minute reviews and logs the decision, that the ED steps down from Level 3 only as far as the platform data supports, that someone gets the state coordinator to send the written confirmation, and that the TM records the status in the operations channel and confirms it with the network desk.
